Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J	o\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone whose object and arrow cocones are colimits of sets [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Fix $i\in J$. For $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, let $A_t:F(t.\mathrm{right})^{\mathrm{op}}	o\mathrm{Ab}$ be a presheaf. For $c:t	o t'$ let $	heta_c:A_t	o F(c.\mathrm{right})^{\mathrm{op}}\star A_{t'}$ be a natural transformation, where $\star$ denotes precomposition. Assume identity and composition hold componentwise as objects of $\mathrm{Arrow}(\mathrm{Ab})$, including the endpoint transports from $F$. Let $B:\mathrm{Under}(i)	o\mathrm{PSh}(V.\mathrm{pt})$ and $ eta_t:A_t	o V_t^{\mathrm{op}}\star B_t$ exhibit $B_t$ as a left Kan extension along $V_t^{\mathrm{op}}$, with $V_t=V_{t.\mathrm{right}}$. A left Kan extension here means that composing with $ eta_t$ bijects natural transformations $B_t	o T$ with natural transformations $A_t	o V_t^{\mathrm{op}}\star T$ for every presheaf $T$ on $V.\mathrm{pt}$. Assume $ eta_t$ followed by $B(c)$ equals $	heta_c$ followed by $ eta_{t'}$ componentwise in $\mathrm{Arrow}(\mathrm{Ab})$. Fix $j,k\in J$ and $a:i	o k$, $b:j	o k$. Let $s=\mathrm{Under.map}(a):\mathrm{Under}(k)	o\mathrm{Under}(i)$ send $(k\xrightarrow{t.\mathrm{hom}}l)$ to $(i\xrightarrow{a\,;\,t.\mathrm{hom}}l)$, and write $g_t=F(b\,;\,t.\mathrm{hom})$, where a semicolon means composition in diagram order. Let $D:\mathrm{Under}(k)	o\mathrm{PSh}(F(j))$ be a diagram with isomorphisms $e_t:D_t\cong g_t^{\mathrm{op}}\star A_{s(t)}$. Assume $D(c)_U\,;\,e_{t',U}=e_{t,U}\,;\,	heta_{s(c),g_t^{\mathrm{op}}(U)}$ in $\mathrm{Arrow}(\mathrm{Ab})$ for every $c:t	o t'$ and $U\in F(j)^{\mathrm{op}}$. Let $
u$ be a cocone on $D$ with vertex $V_j^{\mathrm{op}}\star\operatorname{colim}B$. Assume $
u_{t,U}$ is, in $\mathrm{Arrow}(\mathrm{Ab})$, the composite of $e_{t,U}$, the component of $ eta_{s(t)}$ at $g_t^{\mathrm{op}}(U)$, and the outer coprojection for $B$ at $V_{t.\mathrm{right}}^{\mathrm{op}}(g_t^{\mathrm{op}}(U))$. Then $
u$ is colimiting, formally $\mathrm{Nonempty}(\mathrm{IsColimit}(
u))$. This assertion constructs no sheaf diagram and uses no topology. All presheaves, diagrams, natural transformations and Kan extensions in this statement take values in abelian groups. No sheaf condition is assumed.
title: Compatible abelian stagewise Kan comparison cocone is colimiting

source.place: Tag 0A35 (lemma-compute-pullback-to-limit), arbitrary-object section formula; abelian extension via Modules on Sites, Tag 03CO. Sources read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A35 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03CO; local TeX is absent.

proof.text: Reuse the existing private lift_stage_arrow theorem from ColimitStageKanCocone, accessed with import all, to lift one Kan generator arrow. The transported stage section restricts along this lift. The formulas hbeta_map and hnu, naturality of beta, and e inverse show it is represented by a D section. The representative subset in the vertex group is an additive subgroup: use filteredness to add representatives at one common stage. Every pointwise Kan coprojection lands in this subgroup. Prove that a subgroup containing all coprojection images of an abelian colimit is the whole group by factoring the colimit cocone through the subgroup and its inclusion. Thus all B-stage elements are represented; filtered-set joint surjectivity for the outer B colimit proves surjectivity.

Under.map a is final by the filtered finality criterion, using a common successor and coequalization. Normalize the components e followed by beta with endpoint transports. The formulas hD and hbeta_map prove that they commute with transitions, and hnu identifies them with the cocone maps. Evaluation and forgetting abelian groups preserve the outer filtered colimit. Eventual equality moves two equal cocone images to one stage where the two normalized beta images agree. Cancel the invertible endpoint transport, then apply the abelian Kan-unit relation lemma to the family indexed by Under k. Its later equality, hD, and cancellation of the e component give equality of the D-transition images.

Evaluate nu at each U and forget abelian groups. The representative and relation calculations satisfy Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf. Forgetting reflects this colimit because it reflects isomorphisms, preserves the filtered colimit, and an abelian colimit exists. Finally evaluation jointly reflects presheaf colimits, yielding Nonempty(IsColimit nu).

lean.statement:
theorem colimit_stage_abelian_kan_cocone
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (i : J) (A : ∀ t : Under i, (F.obj t.right)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (c : t ⟶ t'),
      A t ⟶ (F.map c.right).toFunctor.op ⋙ A t')
    (hθid : ∀ (t : Under i) (X : (F.obj t.right)ᵒᵖ),
      Arrow.mk ((θ t t (𝟙 t)).app X) = Arrow.mk (𝟙 ((A t).obj X)))
    (hθcomp : ∀ (t t' t'' : Under i) (c : t ⟶ t') (d : t' ⟶ t'')
        (X : (F.obj t.right)ᵒᵖ),
      Arrow.mk ((θ t t' c).app X ≫
        (θ t' t'' d).app ((F.map c.right).toFunctor.op.obj X)) =
      Arrow.mk ((θ t t'' (c ≫ d)).app X))
    (B : Under i ⥤ (V.ptᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (β : ∀ t : Under i, A t ⟶ (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op ⋙ B.obj t)
    (hβ : ∀ t : Under i, (B.obj t).IsLeftKanExtension (β t))
    (hβmap : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (c : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj t.right),
      Arrow.mk ((β t).app (op X) ≫
        (B.map c).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk ((θ t t' c).app (op X) ≫
        (β t').app (op ((F.map c.right).toFunctor.obj X))))
    (j k : J) (a : i ⟶ k) (b : j ⟶ k)
    (D : Under k ⥤ ((F.obj j)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (e : ∀ t : Under k, D.obj t ≅
      (F.map (b ≫ t.hom)).toFunctor.op ⋙ A ((Under.map a).obj t))
    (hD : ∀ (t t' : Under k) (c : t ⟶ t') (U : (F.obj j)ᵒᵖ),
      Arrow.mk ((D.map c).app U ≫ (e t').hom.app U) =
      Arrow.mk ((e t).hom.app U ≫
        (θ ((Under.map a).obj t) ((Under.map a).obj t') ((Under.map a).map c)).app
          ((F.map (b ≫ t.hom)).toFunctor.op.obj U)))
    (ν : Cocone D)
    (hpt : ν.pt = (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.op ⋙ colimit B)
    (hν : ∀ (t : Under k) (U : (F.obj j)ᵒᵖ),
      Arrow.mk ((ν.ι.app t).app U) =
      Arrow.mk ((e t).hom.app U ≫
        (β ((Under.map a).obj t)).app ((F.map (b ≫ t.hom)).toFunctor.op.obj U) ≫
        (colimit.ι B ((Under.map a).obj t)).app
          ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op.obj
            ((F.map (b ≫ t.hom)).toFunctor.op.obj U)))) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit ν)
